verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is API-first: sessions, scrape, crawl, extract, agents, profiles, recordings, and sandboxes are all documented as programmatic APIs, with SDKs, a CLI, and an MCP server. However, no evidence explicitly states that the API matches the UI/dashboard feature for feature, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API–UI parity, a published OpenAPI spec, API coverage of account/dashboard functions (billing, API keys, team settings), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
